definitions.explanation: A relatively brief period of time, as opposed to a long-term duration. Used in business, education, and general contexts.

examples.japanese: {短期|たんき}の{目標|もくひょう}を{設定|せってい}した。
{短期|たんき}{留学|りゅうがく}で{語学力|ごがくりょく}を{伸|の}ばしたい。
examples.english: I want to improve my language skills through short-term study abroad.

examples.japanese: {短期|たんき}{間|かん}で{結果|けっか}を{出|だ}すのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's difficult to produce results in a short period.
examples.notes: 短期間 = short period of time

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {短期|たんき}{間|かん} (short period)
- {短期|たんき}{大学|だいがく} (junior college, two-year college - abbrev: 短大)
- {短期|たんき}{留学|りゅうがく} (short-term study abroad)
- {短期|たんき}{目標|もくひょう} (short-term goal)
- {短期|たんき}{記憶|きおく} (short-term memory)
- {短期|たんき}{契約|けいやく} (short-term contract)

ANTONYM: {長期|ちょうき} (long term)

NOTE: {短期|たんき}{大学|だいがく} ({短大|たんだい}) is a type of Japanese higher education institution offering 2-3 year programs.
